messages:
javier_supp: Quick heads-up — GreenStack (acct GS-9921) put INV-2026-1487 on hold. Procurement says they need a signed PO in their GS-PO-YYYY-#### format AND their SAP vendor code before payments clear. They also want our W9 and VAT reg.

brooke_billing: Thanks. Drop the invoice id + contact and I'll flag in billing. If they insist on vendor creation in Ariba/SAP, that can pause invoicing until vendor exists (3-7 business days usually).

javier_supp: Invoice INV-2026-1487. Contact: Olivia Park <olivia.park@greenstack.com>. Procurement will only accept signed PDF PO with exact number format. They specifically asked for our VAT reg number and W9.

mike_sales: Can we send SOW + pro-forma so procurement can generate their PO while vendor onboarding runs? If yes, I'll ask Olivia to push on vendor docs.

brooke_billing: We can create a pro-forma labeled clearly "PRO-FORMA — SUBJECT TO RECEIPT OF CUSTOMER PO". Accounting won't recognize revenue on pro-forma. I'll open a ticket and attach SOW + pro-forma.

billing-bot: Billing ticket created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-3241 (reason: PROCUREMENT_PO_REQUIRED; invoice: INV-2026-1487)

anna_ops: Ops note: if customer asks for immediate billing to parent, Legal/Finance approval required. Document any acceptance of liability in writing before switching billing entity.

brooke_billing: Draft email to Olivia done. Asking if an emailed signed PO PDF is acceptable temporarily while Ariba vendor code pending. Email includes our vendor details (EIN + VAT). Will attach SOW + pro-forma.

javier_supp: Olivia replied: procurement is expediting but stuck on "vendor docs" step. They asked whether an emailed signed PO would unblock payment processing. :pray: 

mike_sales: If vendor creation stalls >5bd, Sales suggests billing GreenStack Group (parent) — they have vendor code 55211 — but only with Legal + Finance signoff and a PO from the parent entity.

legal_ops: Confirmed: parent-entity billing OK as fallback. Need written acceptance of liability and a PO referencing parent. Legal needs to review the acceptance wording before proceeding.

brooke_billing: Updated BILL-3241: status "On hold — awaiting customer PO + vendor onboarding docs". Attached pro-forma + SOW. Following up in 48h. @javier_supp paste signed PO here when received and I'll finalize.

javier_supp: Copy. Logging repro steps/internal: 1) created pro-forma, 2) attached SOW to BILL-3241, 3) requested vendor code + vendor form, 4) asked customer if emailed PO is ok, 5) flagged parent-billing fallback to Legal. I'll post any PO here.

brooke_billing: Thanks — setting reminder for 48h follow-up. If we get an emailed PDF PO, billing can convert pro-forma to final invoice once we have signed PO + vendor code. :thumbsup:
